title: The City of Gold's message, twice
description: The City of Gold loads as a sacrifice pit. "IT'S THE LEGENDARY CITY OF GOLD!" shows, then, seven seconds later, the same message again, and only seven seconds after that the pit's "I CAN HEAR PRAYERS TO KALI!".
